source_references.notes: User-authorized browser screen/window capture feeding ROI processing.
Teacher workflow confirms that screen OCR is a pixel bridge, not direct DIS SDK access.

known_boundaries: A user must explicitly choose a screen, window, or tab; construction and configuration do not request permission.
Page reload normally requires permission again, and denial/end are capture lifecycle errors rather than device failures.
The source exposes user-authorized pixels, not device SDK or internal application data; OCR remains downstream.
